settings.heading:
Eight layers.
Each one stated.
settings.lede: You have decided what you want. Thirty five centimetres, a seven-zone pocket spring core, a comfort layer that lifts out. Here is exactly what is in it, so you can check it against what you had in mind.

settings.heading:
What thirty five centimetres
is made of
settings.layer_1_desc: 400 gram, zipped the whole way round
settings.layer_3_desc: One and a half centimetres, 20 density
settings.layer_4_desc: Two and a half centimetres, cut to let air move
settings.layer_5_desc: Ten centimetres. Medium one face, medium firm the other
settings.layer_6_desc: Twenty centimetres. 2.0mm wire at hips and shoulders, 1.8mm elsewhere
settings.layer_7_desc: Seven centimetres, 35 density. The edge holds

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is the same build. Thirty five centimetres, seven-zone core, removable comfort layer. You do not choose a firmness.

settings.heading:
Seven zones, two wire gauges,
every spring in its own pocket
settings.body_1: Two millimetre wire under the hips and shoulders, where the weight lands. One point eight everywhere else. Each spring in its own fabric pocket.
settings.body_2: Twenty centimetres of it, guaranteed for twenty five years. It is the part that does not come out, because it is the part that does not wear.
settings.caption: Seven-zone core

settings.heading:
Medium one face.
Medium firm the other.
settings.body_1: Ten centimetres, two densities laminated together. Turn it over and the feel changes. That is the first adjustment, and it costs nothing.
settings.body_2: If neither face is right, tell us how it should feel and we build a new one to that. For a year, with our compliments.

settings.heading: Zipped the whole way round
settings.body_1: Four hundred gram cool-knit, breathable, closed with a zip that runs the full perimeter. The zip is why the comfort layer can come out.
settings.body_2: Nothing is glued. Nothing is tufted. The build is held together by the cover, which means the build can be opened.
settings.caption: Cover compression

settings.a1_body: A year to tell us how it should feel. We remake the comfort layer to that, with our compliments, as often as it takes.
settings.a2_body: Collected from your home and refunded in full. Emperor is made to order and excluded.
settings.a3_body: The part that carries you is guaranteed for a quarter of a century.
